questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — highest total of 170, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/12.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Highest Individual Score' in the 23/24 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits holds it, with a total of 136, a joint record shared with Faye Tunnicliffe.
